notes: Unmodified official redis-benchmark 8.8.3. Raw CSV rates, no summed client peaks.
Three coallocated idle servers use the same CPU set; only one is loaded at a time. Fresh servers and complete prefill for every size/core case.
Three timed rounds per server rotate engine order; warmup before every round.
All attempts retained. Shared desktop CPU contention is sampled and flagged. Quiet preflight limited to two seconds.
Same 100,000 fully populated random keys for every engine; dataset sizes are compared separately.
Server RSS and cgroup memory sampled every20ms. Persist/evict disabled, swap prohibited.
